environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed via an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or request filtering. ALB access logs enabled but no active monitoring. Python 3.9, Flask 2.3.2, SQLite 3.36.
